meta.title: Heavy Downpour
meta.description: The strongest enemy doesn't necessarily only appear at the end.

units.rawText: Enigma Sector. After the battle, Persicaria and I drag a defeated Lesser Sanctifier off into a corner.
units.displayText: Enigma Sector. After the battle, Persicaria and I drag a defeated Lesser Sanctifier off into a corner.

spans.text: Enigma Sector. After the battle, Persicaria and I drag a defeated Lesser Sanctifier off into a corner.

units.rawText: Your judgement was right. The other Lesser Sanctifiers haven't realized what's going on here.
units.displayText: Your judgement was right. The other Lesser Sanctifiers haven't realized what's going on here.

spans.text: Your judgement was right. The other Lesser Sanctifiers haven't realized what's going on here.

units.rawText: As I thought, communications between Sanctifiers have been affected by the operand fluctuations.
units.displayText: As I thought, communications between Sanctifiers have been affected by the operand fluctuations.

spans.text: As I thought, communications between Sanctifiers have been affected by the operand fluctuations.

units.rawText: So, what have you learned?
units.displayText: So, what have you learned?

spans.text: So, what have you learned?

units.rawText: I've finished decrypting the last orders these Sanctifiers received. They were carrying out orders from a Greater Sanctifier - "find the source of the operand absorption".
units.displayText: I've finished decrypting the last orders these Sanctifiers received. They were carrying out orders from a Greater Sanctifier - "find the source of the operand absorption".

spans.text: I've finished decrypting the last orders these Sanctifiers received. They were carrying out orders from a Greater Sanctifier - "find the source of the operand absorption".

units.rawText: Looks like the Sanctifiers haven't found the exact coordinates yet.
units.displayText: Looks like the Sanctifiers haven't found the exact coordinates yet.

spans.text: Looks like the Sanctifiers haven't found the exact coordinates yet.

units.rawText: Yes. Also, I've sent all this to Antonina, along with information on the operand fluctuations within the sector.
units.displayText: Yes. Also, I've sent all this to Antonina, along with information on the operand fluctuations within the sector.

spans.text: Yes. Also, I've sent all this to Antonina, along with information on the operand fluctuations within the sector.

units.rawText: The data we have now proves that it's very likely the coordinates in the distress signal refer to the position of the operand black hole, just that it's been deliberately concealed.
units.displayText: The data we have now proves that it's very likely the coordinates in the distress signal refer to the position of the operand black hole, just that it's been deliberately concealed.

spans.text: The data we have now proves that it's very likely the coordinates in the distress signal refer to the position of the operand black hole, just that it's been deliberately concealed.

units.rawText: So that "Neumann" agent knows where the operand black hole is, but the Sanctifiers don't?
units.displayText: So that "Neumann" agent knows where the operand black hole is, but the Sanctifiers don't?

spans.text: So that "Neumann" agent knows where the operand black hole is, but the Sanctifiers don't?

units.rawText: That IS very weird. Usually, an agent would go to the Sanctifiers for help when they encountered such a destructive incident.
units.displayText: That IS very weird. Usually, an agent would go to the Sanctifiers for help when they encountered such a destructive incident.

spans.text: That IS very weird. Usually, an agent would go to the Sanctifiers for help when they encountered such a destructive incident.

units.rawText: Yet Neumann avoided the Sanctifiers... Now that I think about it, the specially encrypted distress signal was probably to keep the Sanctifiers from noticing.
units.displayText: Yet Neumann avoided the Sanctifiers... Now that I think about it, the specially encrypted distress signal was probably to keep the Sanctifiers from noticing.

spans.text: Yet Neumann avoided the Sanctifiers... Now that I think about it, the specially encrypted distress signal was probably to keep the Sanctifiers from noticing.

units.rawText: But why...
units.displayText: But why...

spans.text: But why...

units.rawText: Since he went out of his way to avoid the Sanctifiers, it proves that he's not with them, at least.
units.displayText: Since he went out of his way to avoid the Sanctifiers, it proves that he's not with them, at least.

spans.text: Since he went out of his way to avoid the Sanctifiers, it proves that he's not with them, at least.

units.rawText: We now know the black hole's coordinates, so the situation favors us.
units.displayText: We now know the black hole's coordinates, so the situation favors us.

spans.text: We now know the black hole's coordinates, so the situation favors us.

units.rawText: So should we look for Neumann first...
units.displayText: So should we look for Neumann first...

spans.text: So should we look for Neumann first...

units.rawText: Hang on, we've forgotten something...
units.displayText: Hang on, we've forgotten something...

spans.text: Hang on, we've forgotten something...

units.rawText: You're saying...?
units.displayText: You're saying...?

spans.text: You're saying...?

units.rawText: That Greater Sanctifier - did they only issue orders?
units.displayText: That Greater Sanctifier - did they only issue orders?

spans.text: That Greater Sanctifier - did they only issue orders?

units.rawText: ...Indeed, that conclusion makes a lot of sense.
units.displayText: ...Indeed, that conclusion makes a lot of sense.

spans.text: ...Indeed, that conclusion makes a lot of sense.

units.rawText: Just in case, I'll contact Antonina first...
units.displayText: Just in case, I'll contact Antonina first...

spans.text: Just in case, I'll contact Antonina first...

units.rawText: Persicaria suddenly stops speaking.
units.displayText: Persicaria suddenly stops speaking.

spans.text: Persicaria suddenly stops speaking.

units.rawText: Oh? An unfamiliar guest has come to visit.
units.displayText: Oh? An unfamiliar guest has come to visit.

spans.text: Oh? An unfamiliar guest has come to visit.

units.rawText: Now what kind of visitor could be moving around here? Shall we have a chat?
units.displayText: Now what kind of visitor could be moving around here? Shall we have a chat?

spans.text: Now what kind of visitor could be moving around here? Shall we have a chat?

units.rawText: <size=24>A Greater Sanctifier...!</size>
units.displayText: A Greater Sanctifier...!

spans.text: A Greater Sanctifier...!

units.rawText: <size=24>She's supporting those Lesser Sanctifiers with her operands, so her personal fighting strength should be weaker...</size>
units.displayText: She's supporting those Lesser Sanctifiers with her operands, so her personal fighting strength should be weaker...

spans.text: She's supporting those Lesser Sanctifiers with her operands, so her personal fighting strength should be weaker...

units.rawText: Talking face to face is basic manners, you know. If you still don't come out...
units.displayText: Talking face to face is basic manners, you know. If you still don't come out...

spans.text: Talking face to face is basic manners, you know. If you still don't come out...

units.rawText: —You will have to pay the price for your rudeness.
units.displayText: —You will have to pay the price for your rudeness.

spans.text: —You will have to pay the price for your rudeness.
Persicaria!

units.rawText: I subconsciously pull Persicaria away. A keen arrow penetrates the building and zips past Persicaria's ear, slicing off a few strands of hair.
units.displayText: I subconsciously pull Persicaria away. A keen arrow penetrates the building and zips past Persicaria's ear, slicing off a few strands of hair.

spans.text: I subconsciously pull Persicaria away. A keen arrow penetrates the building and zips past Persicaria's ear, slicing off a few strands of hair.

units.rawText: In the very next moment, the blonde Greater Sanctifier appears before our eyes.
units.displayText: In the very next moment, the blonde Greater Sanctifier appears before our eyes.

spans.text: In the very next moment, the blonde Greater Sanctifier appears before our eyes.

units.rawText: (A millimeter to the left and I'd probably be dead...)
units.displayText: A millimeter to the left and I'd probably be dead...

spans.text: A millimeter to the left and I'd probably be dead...

units.rawText: Hehe, you have quick reactions. But after this, you won't have the chance to react.
units.displayText: Hehe, you have quick reactions. But after this, you won't have the chance to react.

spans.text: Hehe, you have quick reactions. But after this, you won't have the chance to react.
(Try to talk.)
(Try to flee.)

units.rawText: Wait — maybe we can talk.
units.displayText: Wait — maybe we can talk.

spans.text: Wait — maybe we can talk.

units.rawText: I know you. You're the Daemon who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist".
units.displayText: I know you. You're the Daemon who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist".

spans.text: I know you. You're the Daemon who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist".

units.rawText: However, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.
units.displayText: However, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.

spans.text: However, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.

units.rawText: Since we could beat those Greater Sanctifiers, it naturally means we have aces up our sleeve.
units.displayText: Since we could beat those Greater Sanctifiers, it naturally means we have aces up our sleeve.

spans.text: Since we could beat those Greater Sanctifiers, it naturally means we have aces up our sleeve.

units.rawText: You want to stop the operand absorption in this sector, right? Then our goals align, if nothing else.
units.displayText: You want to stop the operand absorption in this sector, right? Then our goals align, if nothing else.

spans.text: You want to stop the operand absorption in this sector, right? Then our goals align, if nothing else.

units.rawText: Rather than oppose us, why don't we try to discuss a settlement which benefits both of us?
units.displayText: Rather than oppose us, why don't we try to discuss a settlement which benefits both of us?

spans.text: Rather than oppose us, why don't we try to discuss a settlement which benefits both of us?

units.rawText: You really are very interesting.
units.displayText: You really are very interesting.

spans.text: You really are very interesting.

units.rawText: However... I haven't been reduced to making deals with Irregular Agents to complete my mission!
units.displayText: However... I haven't been reduced to making deals with Irregular Agents to complete my mission!

spans.text: However... I haven't been reduced to making deals with Irregular Agents to complete my mission!

units.rawText: I glance at Persicaria and Persicaria nods.
units.displayText: I glance at Persicaria and Persicaria nods.

spans.text: I glance at Persicaria and Persicaria nods.

units.rawText: A barrier of operands springs up between us and the Greater Sanctifier. Persicaria grabs my hand and we flee toward the edge of the sector.
units.displayText: A barrier of operands springs up between us and the Greater Sanctifier. Persicaria grabs my hand and we flee toward the edge of the sector.

spans.text: A barrier of operands springs up between us and the Greater Sanctifier. Persicaria grabs my hand and we flee toward the edge of the sector.

units.rawText: Using these methods... What a shame.
units.displayText: Using these methods... What a shame.

spans.text: Using these methods... What a shame.

units.rawText: In the next moment, the sound of the barrier shattering comes from behind us.
units.displayText: In the next moment, the sound of the barrier shattering comes from behind us.

spans.text: In the next moment, the sound of the barrier shattering comes from behind us.

units.rawText: I remember now. You're the Daemons who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist", aren't you?
units.displayText: I remember now. You're the Daemons who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist", aren't you?

spans.text: I remember now. You're the Daemons who defeated "Raven" and "Eucharist", aren't you?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.

spans.text: Unfortunately, your pathetic response just now fell far short of my expectations.

units.rawText: The blonde Greater Sanctifier nocks an arrow, pulls her bow taut, then gathers light to the tip of her arrow.
units.displayText: The blonde Greater Sanctifier nocks an arrow, pulls her bow taut, then gathers light to the tip of her arrow.

spans.text: The blonde Greater Sanctifier nocks an arrow, pulls her bow taut, then gathers light to the tip of her arrow.

units.rawText: Much as I'd like to chat, I have more important things to do now, so let's wrap this up quickly.
units.displayText: Much as I'd like to chat, I have more important things to do now, so let's wrap this up quickly.

spans.text: Much as I'd like to chat, I have more important things to do now, so let's wrap this up quickly.

units.rawText: Persica places herself in front of me. Light swirls between her hands as well and forms a transparent barrier in mid-air.
units.displayText: Persica places herself in front of me. Light swirls between her hands as well and forms a transparent barrier in mid-air.

spans.text: Persica places herself in front of me. Light swirls between her hands as well and forms a transparent barrier in mid-air.

units.rawText: The very next moment, a sharp golden light howls through the air toward us.
units.displayText: The very next moment, a sharp golden light howls through the air toward us.

spans.text: The very next moment, a sharp golden light howls through the air toward us.

units.rawText: These Lesser Sanctifiers weren't as badly affected by the operand black hole as we expected. Does that imply there's a Greater Sanctifier inside the sector giving them operand support?
units.displayText: These Lesser Sanctifiers weren't as badly affected by the operand black hole as we expected. Does that imply there's a Greater Sanctifier inside the sector giving them operand support?
